card.title: Quality Director
card.description:
**Quality Director**

**Brunswick Hospital Center (Inpatient Behavioral Healthcare)**

**Amityville, NY**

**Position Summary**

The Quality Director provides strategic leadership for Brunswick Hospital Center’s quality management and performance improvement program. This role is responsible for analyzing trends, identifying systems issues, and driving organization-wide improvement using data provided by the Incident Management / Clinical Risk team.

The position maintains a clear separation of duties so that special investigations and Justice Center case management remain the responsibility of the Incident Management team. The Quality Director ensures alignment with OMH, Joint Commission, CMS, and Justice Center expectations at the systems level.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Quality and Performance Improvement**

* Develop and lead the hospital’s annual Quality and Performance Improvement Plan.
* Design and oversee systems for collecting, analyzing, and reporting quality and incident trend data.
* Chair the Performance Improvement Committee and ensure follow-through on improvement projects.
* Partner with department leaders to establish measurable quality goals and monitor progress.
* Track the implementation and effectiveness of Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) across the organization.
* Support organizational review of sentinel events and high-risk events through systems analysis and monitoring of resulting improvements.

**Collaboration with Incident Management**

* Receive completed investigation findings and case-specific data from the Clinical Risk / Incident Management team.
* Use this information for systems-level analysis and improvement without conducting or duplicating investigations.
* Ensure special investigations and Justice Center case management remain the responsibility of the Incident Management team.

**Compliance and Reporting**

* Prepare and submit required quality and performance improvement reports to internal leadership, the Board, and external agencies (OMH, CMS, Joint Commission) as applicable.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting of quality indicators, trend data, and improvement outcomes.
* Monitor compliance with regulatory reporting timelines and documentation standards related to quality and performance improvement.
* Maintain documentation demonstrating the effectiveness of the quality program for surveys and audits.
* Coordinate the hospital’s response to quality-related findings from external reviews, ensuring corrective actions are tracked to completion.

**Survey Readiness and Regulatory Compliance**

* Coordinate survey readiness activities and maintain ongoing compliance with Joint Commission, CMS, OMH, and related standards.
* Serve as a liaison with OMH on quality and performance improvement matters (distinct from day-to-day incident reporting and Justice Center investigations).
* Oversee systems-level tracking and trending of patient complaints and grievances.

**Leadership and Communication**

* Facilitate communication of quality data and improvement initiatives to medical staff, leadership, and the Board.
* Identify and recommend resources, training, and process changes needed to sustain a culture of safety and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in nursing or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Current RN or NP licensure in New York preferred; other advanced clinical or quality credentials (e.g., CPHQ) considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of progressive quality, performance improvement, or risk management experience in a behavioral health or hospital setting.
* Demonstrated experience with Joint Commission or CMS survey readiness.
* Strong data analysis, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Experience working with OMH or Justice Center expectations at a systems/compliance level preferred.
* Prior supervisory or leadership experience preferred.

* Benefits offered. Salary commensurate with experience.

card.title: Vice President of Quality
card.description:
**Overview**

The Vice President of Quality provides strategic leadership and oversight of all quality functions, ensuring products and manufacturing processes meet customer requirements, applicable quality standards, and company expectations. This position is responsible for developing and executing the company's quality strategy, maintaining an effective quality management system, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

The VP of Quality partners with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to improve manufacturing performance, reduce quality-related costs, resolve complex quality issues, and establish a culture of accountability and operational excellence.

Direct semiconductor manufacturing experience is required. The successful candidate must have 10–15 years of progressive quality experience, including experience in semiconductor equipment manufacturing, with a demonstrated ability to lead quality initiatives and deliver measurable improvements in product quality, process performance, and customer satisfaction.

**Duties**

- Develop and implement the company's quality strategy, objectives, and improvement initiatives in alignment with business goals.

- Provide executive leadership and oversight for all Quality department functions, personnel, systems, and processes.

- Establish, implement, and maintain an effective quality management system in accordance with applicable ISO standards, customer requirements, and industry standards.

- Ensure products and manufacturing processes meet established specifications, customer expectations, and applicable quality requirements.

- Serve as a senior point of contact for customer quality concerns, escalations, audits, corrective actions, and quality performance reviews.

- Manage root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to prevent recurring quality issues.

- Establish and monitor key quality performance indicators, identify trends, and implement improvement plans to reduce defects, scrap, rework, and quality-related costs.

- Partner with Operations, Engineering, Production, and other departments to resolve manufacturing issues and improve process consistency.

- Oversee internal and external quality audits, supplier quality performance, nonconformance management, and compliance activities.

- Ensure appropriate quality resources, inspection equipment, measurement systems, work instructions, and technical documentation are available and maintained.

- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Quality organization with clear performance expectations, accountability, and development plans.

- Promote a culture of quality, teamwork, continuous improvement, and shared responsibility across the organization.

- Report quality performance, significant risks, customer concerns, and improvement initiatives to executive leadership.

- Evaluate quality risks and make sound decisions using technical analysis, available data, customer impact, and business priorities.

- Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, reduce waste, and optimize the use of company resources.

- Maintain effective communication and coordination among Quality, Manufacturing, customers, and suppliers.

- Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Knowledge and Skills

- Extensive knowledge of quality assurance, quality engineering, quality management systems, and manufacturing process controls.

- Direct knowledge and experience with semiconductor manufacturing quality requirements and production processes.

- Strong understanding of statistical process control (SPC), process capability studies, metrology, statistical analysis, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive action methodologies.

- Experience implementing quality systems, managing audits, and driving continuous improvement.

- Ability to interpret technical specifications, engineering drawings, inspection requirements, and manufacturing documentation.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex issues and implement effective solutions.

- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence stakeholders, and establish accountability throughout an organization.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical findings and quality performance to executive leadership, customers, and employees.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and quality reporting and data analysis tools.

- Ability to balance customer expectations, product quality, operational efficiency, and business objectives.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- 7–10 years of progressive quality engineering and quality leadership experience, including direct experience in semiconductor equipment manufacturing.

-Black belt or Green belt certification.

- Semiconductor manufacturing experience is mandatory. General manufacturing quality experience alone does not meet this requirement.

- Demonstrated experience leading quality functions or significant quality initiatives within a semiconductor manufacturing environment.

- Experience with manufacturing process controls, defect reduction, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement.

- Experience managing customer quality requirements, customer and supplier audits, nonconformances, and corrective action programs.

- Proven ability to lead and develop teams, establish strategic priorities, and deliver measurable improvements in product quality and customer satisfaction.

- Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and decision-making skills.

**Responsibility for Work of Others**

Provides executive leadership and oversight for the Quality department, including Quality managers, supervisors, engineers, inspectors, and other quality personnel, as applicable. Establishes departmental objectives, assigns responsibilities, evaluates performance, and ensures adequate staffing, training, and resources to meet company and customer requirements.

**Additional Information**

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as business needs require.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

card.title: Quality Assurance Director
card.description:
**Quality Assurance Director – Folding Carton Packaging**

Carton Service CSI, LLC | Shelby, OH | Full-time, salaried (exempt) | On-site with occasional travel

**About Us**

Our site runs a food safety management system built to the SQF Food Safety Code (Edition 9). To learn more about us, visit www.cartonservice.com.

**The Role**

Reporting to the President, the Quality Assurance Director leads quality assurance across all our carton production. You'll make sure our products meet customer specifications and expectations, keep our quality and food safety systems current, and drive cost-effective quality improvements as a key contributor to our strategic plans.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and develop the QA team and oversee the plant quality system
* Review and approve customer specs, and make sure CSI procedures are followed
* Conduct and document internal, supplier and customer audits, manage our FSC and IMS certifications, and serve as backup SQF Practitioner
* Champion GMPs for food-contact packaging, from low-migration inks to hygiene
* Represent us with customers and suppliers, and partner with internal departments, including Sales and Production

**What You Bring**

* College education in a related field (bachelor's degree preferred)
* 5+ years experience working in a GFSI Certified production plant, preferably packaging
* Proven success leading teams, including cross-functional teams
* Strong communication skills with associates, customers, suppliers and regulators
* Organized and results-driven, able to manage multiple priorities and people

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with SQF, BRCGS or another GFSI food safety program
* FSC chain-of-custody or IMS program experience
* SQF Practitioner, HACCP or auditor training; Microsoft Access skills

**Work Environment**

Office work plus time on the production floor (noise, moving machinery; PPE required) and occasional travel to customer and supplier sites. Must be able to stand, walk, bend and kneel frequently and lift up to 25 lbs.

**What We Offer**

* Salary commensurate with experience
* Medical, Rx, dental and vision insurance
* Short- and long-term disability
* 9 paid holidays plus vacation
* 401(k)

**Ready to Apply?**

Apply through Indeed or send your resume and salary expectations to resume@cartonservice.com.

*Carton Service CSI, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Experience:

* quality (GFSI certified): 5 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

card.title: Sr. Manager Operations
card.description:
**Job Description**

**Ingram Content Group (ICG)**is hiring a **Sr. Manager Operations** to support our **Distribution** team in **Jackson, TN**. The Sr. Manager, Operations manages the daily operations of an assigned area within the Distribution Center and serves as a key partner to the Director, Operations. This role collaborates with the Director on hiring, safety and security, maintenance and repairs, non-product purchasing, and strategic planning to ensure customer service levels and commitments are achieved, while maintaining a zero-error environment.

Want to join a key team that helps the world read?

At Ingram, the Operations team serves a key role within the organization. We ensure that our distribution centers and manufacturing facilities function at maximum efficiency. Safety is a core value in our operations environment. We emphasize this through training, education, and accident prevention programs. Process Improvement is another core value, and through innovations such as voice and Radio Frequency (RF) technologies, as well as feedback from our associates, we work toward constant improvement.

The world is reading, and it is our goal to connect as many people as possible to the content they want in the simplest ways. If you want to be part of a customer-centric team that strives for excellence, collaboration, innovation, we can’t wait to meet you!

**Schedule:**

* Monday-Friday, first shift, with flexibility to work weekends, additional hours, and provide on-call support as business needs require.

**What You’ll Need:**

* College degree OR HS diploma or GED with directly related year-for-year experience
* 6 years’ experience in a high-volume distribution center OR production/manufacturing facility with a clear track record of success
* 5 years’ experience supervising at least 25 or more employees

**What You’ll Do:**

* Achieve and maintain full working knowledge of all aspects of the assigned operation
* Implement a fast-paced, lean distribution system; drive the delivery of products and orders on time.
* Oversee KPIs, goals, and objectives for the management team; set clear goals and expectations for Managers and Area Managers, measure performance, provide feedback, and hold leaders accountable.
* Build a passionate team with a positive, inclusive, results-oriented culture; mentor and develop leaders and staff; manage staff selection and development, ensuring associates are fully trained and cross-trained on systems and procedures.
* Develop, manage, and lead continuous process improvement strategies and initiatives; leverage Lean, Six Sigma, and Performance Improvement tools to enhance productivity.
* Provide strategic-level/long-term planning (3, 6, and 12 months out), including labor planning, rate forecasting, and peak season planning.
* Work closely with support functions (HR, Maintenance/Engineering, Safety, IT, and other leaders) to build and secure support and resources for projects and initiatives.
* Ensure customer service levels exceed requirements and standards; works with management to improve cost-per-unit (CPU)/cost-per-line (CPL) while providing outstanding customer service.
* Collaborate with Senior Management in the planning, development, and launch of processes and strategies for the site; review competitive information and visit other companies to bring in new ideas on operations.
* Oversee the supervision of the operations area, ensuring the timely and accurate movement of materials into and out of the facility.
* Monitor and execute company policies and procedures for HR-related issues, including associate attendance, timekeeping, and performance reviews.
* Control and manage budget costs for all assigned departments/areas.

**Essential Physical Demands:**

* Ability to walk and stand as needed
* Ability to grip/grasp as needed
* Ability to lift/carry in full range of motion up to 60lbs as needed

card.description:
**Director of Operations**

**Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority | Lakeville, New York**

**Salary:$110,000-$130,000 | First Review: December 4, 2026**

**Lead Essential Operations. Develop the Workforce. Prepare for Growth.**

The Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority (LCWSA) is seeking an experienced water and wastewater operations professional to help guide its operations through a period of significant growth and expansion.

Over the past five years, the Authority has expanded its water system by 20% while assuming responsibility for additional treatment facilities. With further growth anticipated, LCWSA is investing in its infrastructure, operations, and workforce to meet increasing demands.

The Director of Operations oversees the Authority's water distribution and sewer collection systems, including maintenance activities, field resources, staff development, regulatory compliance, and a $3.5 million operating budget.

**The Opportunity**

The next Director of Operations will help prepare LCWSA for continued expansion while strengthening daily operations and developing its workforce. Priorities include preventive maintenance, infrastructure planning, effective use of operational resources, and training and mentoring employees as experienced team members approach retirement.

LCWSA seeks a collaborative, hands-on leader who combines practical field experience and technical expertise with sound judgment, organizational skills, and a commitment to staff development. The successful candidate will build strong relationships with employees, Authority leadership, municipal partners, contractors, and regulatory agencies while ensuring safe, reliable service to the communities LCWSA serves.

**Qualifications**

Candidates must meet **one** of the following education and experience requirements:

● A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction, or environmental science, plus four years of qualifying experience; or

● An associate's degree in water/wastewater technology or a related field, plus six years of qualifying experience; or

● A high school diploma or equivalent, plus eight years of qualifying experience.

Qualifying experience must be in water treatment, water distribution, sewer collection or treatment, or construction of water and sewer facilities.

All candidates must have at least three years of cumulative supervisory or leadership experience, which may include employee supervision, project management, operational oversight, or coordination of work activities. A valid driver's license and safe driving record are required.

An engineering background may be beneficial but is not required.

**Compensation & Benefits**

The salary range is **$110,000-$130,000**. Benefits include fully paid health insurance, employer contributions to a Health Savings Account (HSA), participation in the New York State Retirement System, and paid time off.

This is an on-site position based in Lakeville, New York. Livingston County residency is preferred but not required. Relocation assistance may be negotiated.

**Ready to Explore the Opportunity?**

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. A first review of candidates will be 12/4/26.

To apply, submit a resume and cover letter through the Pracademic Partners Recruitment Portal:

https://www.pracademicpartners.com/current-recruitments

**Questions or confidential inquiries:**

Dr. Ian M. Coyle, ICMA-CM 
President & Founder, Pracademic Partners 
ian@pracademicpartners.com | 585.943.0589

*The Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply.*

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $110,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Ability to Commute:

* Geneseo, NY 14454 (Required)

Work Location: In person
